FUNCTION slidingWindowMax(arr, k):
    result <- EMPTY LIST
    deque <- EMPTY DEQUE
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF arr-1:
        // Remove elements out of window from front
        WHILE deque IS NOT empty AND deque[0] <= i - k:
            REMOVE FIRST ITEM FROM deque
        // Maintain decreasing order in deque
        WHILE deque IS NOT empty AND arr[deque[LAST]] <= arr[i]:
            REMOVE LAST ITEM FROM deque
        PUSH i TO deque
        // Add max to result once window is full
        IF i >= k - 1:
            APPEND arr[deque[0]] TO result
    RETURN result
